ch.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
早在突袭 TerraGroup 办公室之前，我就听说过他们在塔科夫的地下设施。

他们说，几个月前在海岸线的疗养院下面，有人发现了一个防空洞，或者甚至是另一个实验室——“迷宫”……我肯定得去调查一下那里，也许能进一步了解 TerraGroup 的目的。

但首先我得收集一些情报。商人们应该知道点什么。
ch.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: Jaeger 说如果我能找到那支在里面失踪的 BEAR 小队的情报，他就会帮忙让我能进到“迷宫”里。我同意了。现在我需要等上几天，再去找 Jaeger 确认。到那时他应该会有关于 Knossos 门禁卡的新情报。
ch.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: Therapist拒绝帮忙。我得想别的办法来获取Knossos门禁卡。

cz.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
Ještě před razií v kanceláři TerraGroup jsem slyšel o jejich podzemních stanovištích v Tarkově.

Říká se, že pod pobřežním Zdravotním Střediskem před pár měsícema našli buď protiatomovej kryt, nebo jinou laboratoř – "Labyrint"... Rozhodně bych to místo měl prozkoumat, možná se dozvím víc o tom, co TerraGroup chystala.

Ale nejdřív musím vyhrabat nějaký informace. Obchodníci by měli něco vědět.
cz.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: Jaeger řekl, že mi pomůže s přístupem do Labyrintu, pokud najdu info o týmu BEAR, kterej se tam ztratil. Souhlasil jsem. Teď musím počkat a za pár dní se s Jaegerem znova sejít. Do tý doby by měl mít nový informace o kartách Knossos.
cz.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: Therapistka mi odmítla pomoct. Budu muset najít jinej způsob, jak získat karty Knossos.

They say that under the coastal Health Reasort, a few months back, they found either a bomb shelter or another lab — "The Labyrinth"... I should definitely check that place, maybe I can learn more about what TerraGroup was up to.

But first I need to dig up some intel. The traders should know something.

fr.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
Même avant le raid sur les bureaux de TerraGroup, j’avais entendu parler de leurs installations souterraines à Tarkov.

On raconte que, sous la station thermale côtière, ils auraient découvert il y a quelques mois soit un abri anti-bombes, soit un autre laboratoire : « le Labyrinthe »… Je devrais absolument aller vérifier cet endroit, peut-être que j’en apprendrai plus sur ce que tramait TerraGroup.

Mais d’abord, je dois mettre la main sur des renseignements. Les marchands devraient savoir quelque chose.
fr.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: Jaeger a dit qu’il m’aiderait à obtenir l’accès au Labyrinthe si je trouvais des infos sur l’escouade BEAR qui y a disparu. J’ai accepté. Maintenant, je dois attendre et recontacter Jaeger dans quelques jours. D’ici là, il devrait avoir de nouvelles informations sur les cartes d'accès Knossos.
fr.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: La Toubib a refusé de m’aider. Je vais devoir trouver un autre moyen d’obtenir les cartes d'accès Knossos.

it.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
Anche prima del raid nell'ufficio della TerraGroup, avevo sentito parlare dei loro siti sotterranei a Tarkov. 

Dicono che sotto il centro benessere costiero, alcuni mesi fa, abbiano trovato un rifugio antiaereo o un altro laboratorio: "Il Labirinto"... Dovrei assolutamente controllare quel posto, forse potrei scoprire qualcosa in più su ciò che stava tramando la TerraGroup. 

Ma prima devo raccogliere alcune informazioni. I commercianti dovrebbero sapere qualcosa.
it.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: Jaeger ha detto che mi aiuterà ad accedere al Labirinto se riesco a trovare informazioni sulla squadra BEAR che è scomparsa lì. Ho accettato. Ora devo aspettare e ricontattare Jaeger tra un paio di giorni. A quel punto dovrebbe avere nuove informazioni sulle chiavi magnetiche di Knossos.
it.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: La Therapist si è rifiutata di aiutarmi. Dovrò trovare un altro modo per ottenere le chiavi magnetiche di Knossos.

jp.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
TerraGroup のオフィスへの襲撃以前から、タルコフにある彼らの地下施設については聞いていた。

沿岸の保養所の地下で、数ヶ月前、防空壕か別の研究所 — 「The Labyrinth」と呼ばれる場所が見つかったらしい... 絶対にその場所を調べなくては。TerraGroup が何を企んでいたか、もっと詳しく知れるかもしれない。

だがまずは、情報を見つけ出す必要がある。トレーダーたちなら何か知っているはずだ。
jp.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: Jeager は The Labyrinth で行方不明になった BEAR 部隊の情報を見つけられれば、Labyrinth へのアクセスを手伝うと言っていた。俺は承諾した。数日待って Jeager に確認しに行く必要がある。その頃には Knossos にキーカードに関する新しい情報が入っているはずだ。
jp.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: Therapist は協力を拒否した。Knossos のキーカードを手に入れる別の方法を探さなければ。

kr.68e3aa759490da153915d7bb_hint: 상인 중 누군가는 내가 필요한 정보가 있을지도 모른다
kr.68e3aa7c8d0dd19dc845cbcc_hint: 어째서인지 테라피스트가 시설과 연관되어있는거 같다; 그녀에게 시설 접근 방법에 대해 물어봐야 할 것 같다
kr.68ffff4e3335c4199504704e questNoteText:
테라그룹 사무실을 급습하기 전부터, 타르코프 곳곳에 숨어 있는 지하 시설들에 대해 들은 적이 있었다.

해안가 헬스 리조트 아래에서 몇 달 전, 방공호인지 또 다른 연구실인지 모를 장소—"미궁"이 발견됐다고 한다. 꼭 확인해봐야 한다. 테라그룹이 무슨 짓을 하고 있었는지 실마리를 찾을 수 있을지도 모른다.

하지만 먼저 정보부터 모아야 한다. 상인들이라면 뭔가 알고 있을 것이다.
kr.68ffff5ffa562d9f24018a6b questNoteText: 예거는 실종된 BEAR 분대에 대한 정보를 가져오면 미궁으로 들어가는 길을 도와주겠다고 했다. 수락했다. 이틀 정도 지나 다시 찾아오라고 했다. 그때쯤이면 Knossos 키카드 관련 새 정보가 있을 거라고 한다.
kr.68ffff6cbe226570590ca28a questNoteText: 테라피스트는 협조를 거부했다. Knossos 키카드는 다른 방법으로 구해야 한다.

Теперь нужно подождать и вернуться к Егерю через пару дней. К этому времени у него точно будет новая информация по поводу ключ-карт Knossos.

ch.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaeger 的朋友正在试图查明那支在撤离期间突入“迷宫”的 BEAR 小队到底遭遇什么。这支队伍完成了他们的行动，但之后所有联络都中断了，“迷宫”也随之被封锁。作为提供 Knossos 门禁卡的条件，Jaeger 要我查出他们当时的情况。我得仔细搜索“迷宫”里的所有通道，并弄清楚这支队伍上一次突袭之后到底发生了什么。

这干起来并不容易，但我能更好地了解整个地下建筑群，还能有机会挖出 TerraGroup 秘密研究的内情。所以还是值得冒险的，况且，我办成这件差事还能提升我在 Jaeger 那里的声望。他给了我一张 Knossos 门禁卡，应该能打开“迷宫”的入口。整座 TerraGroup 秘密地下设施，以及里面蕴藏着的所有罪恶，将在我的面前轰然洞开。
ch.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: 我把记录 BEAR 小队在“迷宫”里遭遇的那盘录音带交给了 Jaeger。这就够了，Jaeger 说他会把带子转交给他的战友。
ch.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: 呼号 Leshy 的小队指挥官下令停止寻找出口，并让所有人向 #1156 项目所在的车间集合。看样子这支精英小队就这样被困在了“迷宫”里，但目前还不清楚是到底发生了什么，以及为什么他们会被困住。我需要找到这个所谓的“项目”，并调查这东西的具体情况。
ch.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: 我没有在 #1156 项目车间里那些 BEAR 的尸体里找到 Leshy。他可能继续深入“迷宫”寻找出口了。
ch.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: 小队指挥官命令队员在 #1156 项目车间周围设立防线。但不知为何，他自己却走出了警戒范围。他有留下了一本日志，里面应该会有更多信息。
ch.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: 看起来 TerraGroup 在“迷宫”里进行某种人体实验。当 BEAR 小队突入时，工作人员躲进了更深的地方，并打开了装着实验对象的笼子。但我既没有找到这些主管的踪影，也没有搜出任何文件。
ch.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: 我设法打开了那个“迷宫”高级主管把自己困在里面的办公室。他已经自杀了，但在死之前，他在一盘录音带上录下了一些东西。
ch.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
现在已经清楚 BEAR 小队在突袭期间的遭遇了。小队刚突入设施，“迷宫”里的 TerraGroup 的工作人员就封锁了所有出入口。然后那名高级研究员把笼子里的试验对象都给放了出来。就算这些人长期处于疯狂与极度疲惫的边缘，就算他们手无寸铁、没有任何战斗训练，却把所有 BEAR 队员全部残忍地杀害了。

真是太悲惨了……然而，再残酷的真相也好过继续懵懂无知。
ch.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: 我找到了一堆实验技术人员的笔记。它们包含了大量关于实验对象的信息。

cz.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaegerův kámoš se snaží zjistit, co se stalo s týmem BEAR, kterej během evakuace vtrhnul do Labyrintu. Tým dokončil operaci, ale pak se veškerý spojení přerušilo a Labyrint byl zapečetěnej. Výměnou za karty Knossos chce Jaeger, abych zjistil, co se s nima stalo. Budu muset pečlivě prohledat všechny chodby v Labyrintu a zjistit, co se dělo po útoku.

Není to lehká práce, ale líp pochopím celej komplex a budu mít šanci vyhrabat výzkum TerraGroup. Takže to stojí za to a pomůže mi to vybudovat si reputaci u Jaegera. Dal mi kartu Knossos, která by měla otevřít vchod do Labyrintu. Cesta do komplexu TerraGroup je teď otevřená.
cz.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Předal jsem Jaegerovi nahrávku s podrobnostma o tom, co se stalo s týmem BEAR v Labyrintu. To stačilo a řekl, že to předá svýmu soudruhovi.
cz.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: Velitel jednotky s volacím znakem Leshy nařídil zastavit hledání východů a všem se přeskupit u Položky 1156. Vypadá to, že někdo uvěznil agenty v Labyrintu, ale není jasný, jak nebo proč. Musím najít tuhle "Položku" a zkontrolovat to tam.
cz.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Nenašel jsem Leshyho mezi agenty u Položky 1156. Možná pokračoval v hledání východů v Labyrintu.
cz.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: Velitel družstva nařídil týmu opevnit se u Položky 1156, ale z nějakého důvodu se sám vydal mimo perimetr. Má deník, ve kterém by měly být další informace.
cz.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: Vypadá to, že TerraGroup prováděl v Labyrintu nějaké experimenty na lidech. Když tam vtrhl tým BEAR, zaměstnanci se schovali hlouběji a otevřeli klece s testovacími subjekty. Ale žádné z manažerů ani dokumenty jsem ještě nenašel.
cz.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: Podařilo se mi otevřít kancelář, ve které se zabarikádoval vedoucí pracovník Labyrintu. Zabil se, ale než zemřel, nahrál něco na pásku.
cz.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Teď už je jasné, co se stalo s týmem BEAR po útoku. Hned jak se tým dostal dovnitř, zaměstnanci Labyrintu zamkli všechny vchody a východy. Potom vedoucí zaměstnanec vypustil testovací subjekty z klecí. Ti lidé byli dlouho na pokraji šílenství a vyčerpání, a tak zlikvidovali všechny BEARy, i když byli neozbrojení a neměli žádný bojový výcvik.

Hrozný osud… ale znát pravdu je lepší než žít v lži.
cz.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: Našel jsem spoustu poznámek od laboratorních techniků. Obsahují spoustu informací o testovacích subjektech.

en.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaeger’s friend is trying to learn what happened to the BEAR squad that stormed The Labyrinth during the evacuation. The team completed their operation, but then all contact went dead and The Labyrinth was sealed. In exchange for the Knossos keycards, Jaeger wants me to find out what happened to them. I’ll have to carefully sweep all the passages in The Labyrinth and figure out what went on after the assault.

It’s not an easy job, but I’ll get a better understanding of the complex and a chance to dig up TerraGroup research. So it’s worth doing, and it’ll help build my rep with Jaeger. He gave me a Knossos keycard that should open The Labyrinth entrance. The way into the TerraGroup complex is now open.
en.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: I handed Jaeger the tape detailing what happened to the BEAR squad in The Labyrinth. That was enough, and he said he’d pass it on to his comrade.
en.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: The squad commander with the call sign Leshy ordered the search for exits to stop and for everyone to regroup at Item 1156. Looks like someone trapped the operatives in The Labyrinth, but it’s unclear how or why. I need to find this "Item" and check things out there.
en.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: I didn’t find Leshy among the operatives at Item 1156. He might have continued searching for exits in The Labyrinth.
en.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: The squad commander ordered the team to fortify at Item 1156, but for some reason, he himself went outside the perimeter. He’s got a journal, which should hold more information.
en.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: It looks like TerraGroup was conducting some kind of human experiments in The Labyrinth. When the BEAR squad stormed in, the staff hid deeper inside and opened the cages with the test subjects. But I still haven’t found any of the managers or documents.
en.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: I managed to open the office where the senior Labyrinth staff member had barricaded himself. He killed himself, but before dying, he recorded something on a tape.
en.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Now it’s clear what happened to the BEAR squad after the assault. Right after the team got in, the Labyrinth staff locked all the entrances and exits. Then the senior employee released the test subjects from their cages. These people had long been on the brink of madness and exhaustion, and they took out all the BEARs, even though they were unarmed and had no combat training.

A terrible fate… but knowing the truth is better than living a lie.
en.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: I found a bunch of notes from the lab technicians. They contain a lot of information about the test subjects.

fr.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Un ami de Jaeger essaie de comprendre ce qui est arrivé à l’escouade BEAR qui a pris d’assaut le Labyrinthe pendant l’évacuation. L’équipe a mené son opération à terme, puis tout contact a été perdu et le Labyrinthe a été scellé. En échange des cartes d'accès Knossos, Jaeger veut que je découvre ce qui leur est arrivé. Je vais devoir ratisser soigneusement tous les couloirs du Labyrinthe et comprendre ce qui s’est passé après l’assaut.

Ce n’est pas un boulot facile, mais ça me permettra de mieux comprendre le complexe et d’avoir une chance de mettre la main sur des recherches de TerraGroup. Donc ça vaut le coup, et ça améliorera ma réputation avec Jaeger. Il m’a donné une carte d'accès Knossos qui devrait ouvrir l’entrée du Labyrinthe. L’accès au complexe TerraGroup est désormais ouvert.
fr.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: J’ai remis à Jaeger l’enregistrement détaillant ce qui est arrivé à l’escouade BEAR dans le Labyrinthe. Ça lui a suffi, et il a dit qu’il le transmettrait à son camarade.
fr.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: Le commandant de l’escouade, indicatif Leshy, a ordonné d’arrêter la recherche de sorties et de regrouper tout le monde à l’Objet 1156. On dirait que quelqu’un a piégé les opérateurs dans le Labyrinthe, mais on ne sait ni comment ni pourquoi. Je dois trouver cet « Objet » et aller voir ce qu’il s’y passe.
fr.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Je n’ai pas trouvé Leshy parmi les opérateurs à l’Objet 1156. Il a peut-être continué à chercher des sorties dans le Labyrinthe.
fr.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: Le commandant a ordonné à l’équipe de se retrancher à l’Objet 1156, mais pour une raison quelconque, lui-même est sorti du périmètre. Il a un journal, qui devrait contenir plus d’informations.
fr.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: On dirait que TerraGroup menait une sorte d’expérimentation humaine dans le Labyrinthe. Quand l’escouade BEAR a donné l’assaut, le personnel s’est replié plus profondément et a ouvert les cages des cobayes. Mais je n’ai toujours trouvé ni responsable ni documents.
fr.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: J’ai réussi à ouvrir le bureau où un employé haut placé du Labyrinthe s’était barricadé. Il s’est suicidé, mais avant de mourir, il a enregistré quelque chose sur une cassette.
fr.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Maintenant, c’est clair ce qui est arrivé à l’escouade BEAR après l’assaut. Juste après l’entrée de l’équipe, le personnel du Labyrinthe a verrouillé toutes les entrées et sorties. Ensuite, l’employé principal a relâché les cobayes de leurs cages. Ces gens étaient depuis longtemps au bord de la folie et de l’épuisement, et ils ont éliminé tous les BEAR, alors même qu’ils n’étaient pas armés et n’avaient aucune formation au combat.

Un destin terrible… mais connaître la vérité vaut mieux que vivre dans le mensonge.
fr.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: J’ai trouvé tout un tas de notes des techniciens du labo. Elles contiennent beaucoup d’informations sur les cobayes.

ge.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaeger’s friend is trying to learn what happened to the BEAR squad that stormed The Labyrinth during the evacuation. The team completed their operation, but then all contact went dead and The Labyrinth was sealed. In exchange for the Knossos keycards, Jaeger wants me to find out what happened to them. I’ll have to carefully sweep all the passages in The Labyrinth and figure out what went on after the assault.

It’s not an easy job, but I’ll get a better understanding of the complex and a chance to dig up TerraGroup research. So it’s worth doing, and it’ll help build my rep with Jaeger. He gave me a Knossos keycard that should open The Labyrinth entrance. The way into the TerraGroup complex is now open.
ge.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: I handed Jaeger the tape detailing what happened to the BEAR squad in The Labyrinth. That was enough, and he said he’d pass it on to his comrade.
ge.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: The squad commander with the call sign Leshy ordered the search for exits to stop and for everyone to regroup at Item 1156. Looks like someone trapped the operatives in The Labyrinth, but it’s unclear how or why. I need to find this "Item" and check things out there.
ge.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: I didn’t find Leshy among the operatives at Item 1156. He might have continued searching for exits in The Labyrinth.
ge.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: The squad commander ordered the team to fortify at Item 1156, but for some reason, he himself went outside the perimeter. He’s got a journal, which should hold more information.
ge.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: It looks like TerraGroup was conducting some kind of human experiments in The Labyrinth. When the BEAR squad stormed in, the staff hid deeper inside and opened the cages with the test subjects. But I still haven’t found any of the managers or documents.
ge.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: I managed to open the office where the senior Labyrinth staff member had barricaded himself. He killed himself, but before dying, he recorded something on a tape.
ge.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Now it’s clear what happened to the BEAR squad after the assault. Right after the team got in, the Labyrinth staff locked all the entrances and exits. Then the senior employee released the test subjects from their cages. These people had long been on the brink of madness and exhaustion, and they took out all the BEARs, even though they were unarmed and had no combat training.

A terrible fate… but knowing the truth is better than living a lie.
ge.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: I found a bunch of notes from the lab technicians. They contain a lot of information about the test subjects.

it.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
L'amico di Jaeger sta cercando di scoprire cosa è successo alla squadra BEAR che ha assaltato il Labirinto durante l'evacuazione. La squadra ha completato la sua operazione, ma poi tutti i contatti sono stati interrotti e il Labirinto è stato sigillato. In cambio delle chiavi magnetiche di Knossos, Jaeger vuole che io scopra cosa è successo loro. Dovrò setacciare attentamente tutti i passaggi del Labirinto e capire cosa è successo dopo l'assalto.

Non è un lavoro facile, ma potrò capire meglio il complesso e avrò la possibilità di scavare nella ricerca della TerraGroup. Quindi vale la pena farlo e mi aiuterà a costruire la mia reputazione con Jaeger. Mi ha dato una chiave magnetica di Knossos che dovrebbe aprire l'ingresso del Labirinto. La strada per il complesso della TerraGroup è ora aperta.
it.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Ho consegnato a Jaeger il nastro che descriveva in dettaglio ciò che era successo alla squadra BEAR nel Labirinto. È stato sufficiente e lui ha detto che lo avrebbe passato al suo compagno.
it.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: Il comandante della squadra con il nome in codice Leshy ha ordinato di interrompere la ricerca delle uscite e di riunirsi tutti all'Item 1156. Sembra che qualcuno abbia intrappolato gli agenti nel Labirinto, ma non è chiaro come o perché. Devo trovare questo "Item" e controllare cosa succede lì.
it.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Non ho trovato Leshy tra gli agenti dell'Item 1156. Potrebbe aver continuato a cercare le uscite nel Labirinto.
it.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: Il comandante della squadra ha ordinato alla squadra di fortificarsi all'Item 1156, ma per qualche motivo lui stesso è uscito dal perimetro. Ha un diario che dovrebbe contenere ulteriori informazioni.
it.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: Sembra che TerraGroup stesse conducendo una sorta di esperimenti sugli esseri umani nel Labirinto. Quando la squadra BEAR ha fatto irruzione, il personale si è nascosto più all'interno e ha aperto le gabbie con i soggetti dei test. Ma non ho ancora trovato nessuno dei responsabili né alcun documento.
it.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: Sono riuscito ad aprire l'ufficio dove si era barricato il membro anziano dello staff di Labyrinth. Si è suicidato, ma prima di morire ha registrato qualcosa su un nastro.
it.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Ora è chiaro cosa è successo alla squadra BEAR dopo l'assalto. Subito dopo l'ingresso della squadra, il personale del Labirinto ha bloccato tutti gli ingressi e le uscite. Poi il dipendente senior ha liberato i soggetti dei test dalle loro gabbie. Queste persone erano da tempo sull'orlo della follia e dell'esaurimento e hanno eliminato tutti i BEAR, anche se erano disarmati e non avevano alcun addestramento al combattimento.

Un destino terribile... ma conoscere la verità è meglio che vivere nella menzogna.
it.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: Ho trovato una serie di appunti dei tecnici di laboratorio. Contengono molte informazioni sui soggetti sottoposti al test.

jp.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jeager の友人が避難中に The Labyrinth を急襲した BEAR 分隊に何が起こったのかを突き止めようとしている。部隊は作戦を完了したが、その後連絡が途絶え、The Labyrinth は封鎖された。Jeager は Knossos のカードキーと引き換えに、彼らに何が起こったのかを突き止めて欲しいらしい。The Labyrinth の通路をくまなく調査し、急襲後の経緯を突き止めなくては。

簡単な仕事ではないが、この施設への理解を深め、TerraGroup の研究を見つけ出すチャンスだ。だからやる価値はあるし、Jeagere との信頼関係を築く助けになるだろう。The Labyrinth の入口を開けられる Knossos のキーカードをくれた。TerraGroup の施設への道が開かれた。
jp.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Jeager に The Labyrinth で BEAR 分隊に起きた出来頃を記録したテープを渡した。それで十分だった、彼はそれを同志に渡すと言っていた。
jp.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: コールサイン Leshy の分隊長は出口の捜索を中止し、全員をアイテム 1156 の地点に集合させるように命じた。どうやら誰かがオペレーターたちを The Labyrinth に閉じ込めたようだが、その方法や理由は不明だ。この「アイテム」を見つけて現地を調査する必要がある。
jp.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: アイテム 1156 の地点で、オペレーターの中に Leshy は見つからなかった。彼は The Labyrinth で出口を探し続けているのかもしれない。
jp.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: 分隊長は部隊にアイテム 1156 地点で陣地を築くよう命じたが、何らかの理由で自身は陣の外に出た。彼は日誌を持っていて、そこにはさらなる情報があるはずだ。
jp.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: TerraGroup は The Labyrinth で何らかの人体実験を行っていたようだ。BEAR 分隊が突入した際、スタッフは奥深くに隠れ、被験者が収容された檻を開けた。しかし、管理者や書類はまだ見つかっていない。
jp.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: なんとか Labyrinth の上級スタッフが立てこもったオフィスを開けることが出来た。彼は自殺したが、死ぬ前にテープに何かを録音していた。
jp.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
襲撃後の BEAR 分隊に何が起こったのか明らかになった。部隊が侵入した直後、Labyrinth の職員が全ての出入り口を封鎖した。その後、シニアスタッフが被験者を檻から解放した。彼らは既に狂気と疲労の限界に達しており、非武装で戦闘訓練も受けていないにも関わらず BEAR を全滅させた。

恐ろしい結末だ... だが、真実を知ることは嘘に生きるよりましだ。

kr.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
예거의 지인이 대피 중 미궁에 돌입한 BEAR 분대에 무슨 일이 있었는지 조사 중이라고 한다. 작전은 성공했지만 그 직후 교신이 완전히 끊겼고, 미궁은 봉쇄되었다. 예거는 Knossos 키카드를 주는 조건으로 분대에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 밝혀오라고 했다. 미궁의 복도들을 전부 훑고, 돌입 이후 무슨 일이 일어났는지 파악해야 한다.

쉬운 일은 아니지만, 복합 시설 구조를 이해할 수 있고 테라그룹 연구에 대한 단서도 얻을 수 있다. 무엇보다 예거와의 신뢰도에도 도움이 된다. 예거는 입구를 열 수 있는 Knossos 키카드를 넘겨줬다. 테라그룹 시설로 들어갈 길이 열렸다.
kr.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: 미궁에서 BEAR 분대에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 담긴 테이프를 예거에게 넘겼다. 그걸로 충분하다고 했고, 동료에게 전달해주겠다고 했다.
kr.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: 분대장 레시는 탈출구 탐색을 중지하고 전원이 Item 1156 지점으로 집결하라고 명령했다. 누군가가 BEAR 요원들을 미궁안에 가둔 것 같다. 어떻게, 왜인지는 알 수 없다. Item 1156을 찾아가 직접 확인해야 한다.
kr.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Item 1156에 도착했지만 레시는 보이지 않았다. 아마 미궁 내부에서 탈출구 탐색을 계속했을지도 모른다.
kr.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: 분대장은 팀원들에게 Item 1156에서 방어 진지를 구축하라고 명령했지만 정작 그는 외곽으로 나갔다. 그의 수첩에는 더 많은 정보가 있을 것이다.
kr.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: 미궁에서 테라그룹이 인간 실험을 하고 있었던 흔적이 보인다. BEAR 분대가 돌입하자 직원들은 더 깊숙한 곳으로 숨어들었고, 실험체들을 가둔 우리를 열어버렸다. 하지만 아직 관리자나 문서들은 찾지 못했다.
kr.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: 미궁 최고 책임자가 바리케이드를 치고 숨어 있던 사무실을 열었다. 그는 스스로 목숨을 끊었고, 죽기 전 무언가를 테이프에 남겨두었다.
kr.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
이제 BEAR 분대에게 무슨 일이 벌어졌는지 명확해졌다. 분대가 진입하자마자 직원들이 모든 출입구를 봉쇄했고, 최고 직원이 실험체들을 풀어버렸다. 실험체들은 오랜 격리와 피폐함 끝에 광기에 가까웠고, 전투 훈련도 없는 상태였지만 BEAR 전원을 처치했다.

끔찍한 최후지만… 진실을 아는 것이 거짓 속에 사는 것보다는 낫다.

pl.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaeger’s friend is trying to learn what happened to the BEAR squad that stormed The Labyrinth during the evacuation. The team completed their operation, but then all contact went dead and The Labyrinth was sealed. In exchange for the Knossos keycards, Jaeger wants me to find out what happened to them. I’ll have to carefully sweep all the passages in The Labyrinth and figure out what went on after the assault.

It’s not an easy job, but I’ll get a better understanding of the complex and a chance to dig up TerraGroup research. So it’s worth doing, and it’ll help build my rep with Jaeger. He gave me a Knossos keycard that should open The Labyrinth entrance. The way into the TerraGroup complex is now open.
pl.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: I handed Jaeger the tape detailing what happened to the BEAR squad in The Labyrinth. That was enough, and he said he’d pass it on to his comrade.
pl.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: The squad commander with the call sign Leshy ordered the search for exits to stop and for everyone to regroup at Item 1156. pl.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: I didn’t find Leshy among the operatives at Item 1156. He might have continued searching for exits in The Labyrinth.
pl.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: The squad commander ordered the team to fortify at Item 1156, but for some reason, he himself went outside the perimeter. He’s got a journal, which should hold more information.
pl.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: It looks like TerraGroup was conducting some kind of human experiments in The Labyrinth. When the BEAR squad stormed in, the staff hid deeper inside and opened the cages with the test subjects. But I still haven’t found any of the managers or documents.
pl.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: I managed to open the office where the senior Labyrinth staff member had barricaded himself. He killed himself, but before dying, he recorded something on a tape.
pl.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Now it’s clear what happened to the BEAR squad after the assault. Right after the team got in, the Labyrinth staff locked all the entrances and exits. Then the senior employee released the test subjects from their cages. These people had long been on the brink of madness and exhaustion, and they took out all the BEARs, even though they were unarmed and had no combat training.

A terrible fate… but knowing the truth is better than living a lie.
pl.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: I found a bunch of notes from the lab technicians. They contain a lot of information about the test subjects.

po.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
O amigo de Jaeger está tentando descobrir o que aconteceu com o esquadrão BEAR que invadiu o Labirinto durante a evacuação. A equipe concluiu a operação, mas todo o contato foi perdido e o Labirinto foi selado. Em troca dos cartões de acesso de Knossos, Jaeger quer que eu descubra o que aconteceu com eles. Terei que vasculhar cuidadosamente todas as passagens do Labirinto e descobrir o que aconteceu após o ataque.

Não é um trabalho fácil, mas vou entender melhor o complexo e ter a chance de desenterrar pesquisas da TerraGroup. Então vale a pena, e isso ajudará a aumentar minha reputação com Jaeger. Ele me deu um cartão de acesso de Knossos que deve abrir a entrada do Labirinto. O caminho para o complexo da TerraGroup agora está aberto.
po.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Entreguei a Jaeger a fita com os detalhes do que aconteceu com o esquadrão BEAR no Labirinto. Isso foi o suficiente, e ele disse que a passaria para seu camarada.
po.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: O comandante do esquadrão, com o codinome Leshy, ordenou que a busca por saídas fosse interrompida e que todos se reagrupassem no Item 1156. Parece que alguém prendeu os agentes no Labirinto, mas não está claro como ou por quê. Preciso encontrar esse "Item" e verificar o que está acontecendo lá.
po.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Não encontrei Leshy entre os agentes no Item 1156. Ele pode ter continuado procurando saídas no Labirinto.
po.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: O comandante do esquadrão ordenou que a equipe se fortificasse no Item 1156, mas, por algum motivo, ele próprio saiu do perímetro. Ele tem um diário, que deve conter mais informações.
po.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: Parece que a TerraGroup estava realizando algum tipo de experimento humano no Labirinto. Quando a equipe BEAR invadiu o local, os funcionários se esconderam mais adentro e abriram as jaulas com os indivíduos usados ​​como cobaias. Mas ainda não encontrei nenhum dos gerentes ou documentos.
po.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: Consegui abrir o escritório onde o funcionário sênior do Labirinto havia se barricado. Ele se matou, mas antes de morrer, gravou algo em uma fita.
po.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Agora está claro o que aconteceu com a equipe BEAR após o ataque. Logo depois que a equipe entrou, os funcionários do Labirinto trancaram todas as entradas e saídas. Em seguida, o funcionário sênior libertou os indivíduos de teste de suas jaulas. Essas pessoas já estavam à beira da loucura e da exaustão, e atacaram todos os membros da equipe BEAR, mesmo estando desarmados e sem nenhum treinamento de combate.

Um destino terrível… mas saber a verdade é melhor do que viver uma mentira.
po.68ffffe55b2af7f913036726 questNoteText: Encontrei várias anotações dos técnicos de laboratório. Elas contêm muitas informações sobre os participantes dos testes.

El amigo de Jaeger trata de averiguar qué ocurrió con el escuadrón BEAR que asaltó Labyrinth durante la evacuación. El equipo completó su operación, pero entonces se perdió toda comunicación y Labyrinth quedó sellado. A cambio de las tarjetas de acceso de Knossos, Jaeger quiere que investigue qué les ocurrió. Tendré que inspeccionar cuidadosamente todos los pasillos de Labyrinth y descubrir qué pasó después del asalto.

No es una tarea fácil, pero así conoceré mejor las instalaciones y tendré la oportunidad de indagar en las investigaciones de TerraGroup. Así que merece la pena hacerlo y me ayudará a mejorar mi reputación con Jaeger. Me ha dado una tarjeta de acceso de Knossos que debería abrir la entrada a Labyrinth. Ahora el camino hacia las instalaciones de TerraGroup está abierto.
es.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Le entregué a Jaeger la cinta en la que se detallaba lo que sucedió con el escuadrón BEAR en Labyrinth. Eso fue suficiente, y ha dicho que la pasará a su camarada.
es.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: El comandante del escuadrón, con el distintivo de Leshy, ordenó detener la búsqueda de salidas y que todos se reagruparan en el Objeto 1156. Parece que alguien encerró a los operadores en Labyrinth, pero no está claro cómo o por qué. Debo encontrar este "Objeto" y averiguar qué está pasando allí.
es.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: No encontré a Leshy entre los operadores cerca del Objeto 1156. Puede que él haya seguido buscando salidas de Labyrinth.
es.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: El comandante del escuadrón ordenó al equipo que se atrincherara en el Objeto 1156, pero por alguna razón, él mismo salió del perímetro. Llevaba un diario, que debería contener más información.
es.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: Parece que TerraGroup llevaba a cabo alguna especie de experimentos con humanos en Labyrinth. Cuando el escuadrón BEAR irrumpió en el lugar, el personal se escondió en las profundidades del complejo y abrió las jaulas con los sujetos de prueba. Pero aún no he encontrado a ninguno de los encargados ni ningún documento.
es.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: He conseguido abrir la oficina donde el miembro sénior del personal de Labyrinth se había atrincherado. Se suicidó, pero antes de morir, grabó algo en una cinta.
es.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Ahora está claro qué ocurrió con el equipo BEAR tras el asalto. Justo después de que el equipo entrara, el personal del Labyrinth cerró todas las entradas y salidas. Después, el empleado sénior liberó a los sujetos de prueba de sus jaulas. Estas personas llevaban mucho tiempo al borde de la locura y el agotamiento, y destrozaron a todos los BEAR, a pesar de que iban desarmadas y no tenían entrenamiento en combate. 

Un destino terrible… pero saber la verdad es mejor que vivir en la mentira.

ru.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Товарищ Егеря пытается узнать судьбу группы бирцов, которая штурмовала Лабиринт ещё во время эвакуации. Бойцы успешно провели операцию, но потом связь пропала, а Лабиринт оказался закрыт. В обмен на ключ-карты Knossos Егерь хочет, чтобы я узнал, что с ними произошло. Придётся тщательно осмотреть все ходы в Лабиринте и наверняка узнать, что происходило там после штурма.

Работа непростая, но вместе с этим я смогу лучше понять назначение комплекса и поискать информацию об исследованиях TerraGroup. Так что дело того стоит, да и с Егерем контакт налажу. Егерь выдал мне ключ-карту Knossos, которая должна открыть вход в Лабиринт. Теперь дорога в комплекс TerraGroup открыта.
ru.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: Я передал Егерю кассету, описывающую, что произошло с бирцами в Лабиринте. Этого оказалось достаточно, и он сказал, что передаст её своему товарищу.
ru.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: Командир отряда с позывным Леший приказал прекратить поиск выходов и сгруппироваться у Изделия 1156. Получается, что кто-то запер бойцов в Лабиринте, но непонятно как и зачем. Нужно найти это Изделие и осмотреться там.
ru.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: Я не нашёл Лешего среди бойцов у Изделия 1156. Возможно, он продолжил искать выходы из Лабиринта.
ru.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: Командир группы приказал отряду укрепиться у Изделия 1156, но сам почему-то вышел за периметр. С собой у него есть дневник, в котором я смогу найти больше информации.
ru.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: Судя по всему, в Лабиринте TerraGroup проводила какие-то опыты на людях. Когда бирцы провели штурм, персонал скрылся где-то в глубине и открыл клетки с подопытными. Но я всё ещё не нашёл ни менеджеров, ни документов.
ru.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: Я смог открыть кабинет, в котором заперся старший сотрудник Лабиринта. Он застрелился, но перед смертью записал что-то на диктофон.
ru.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Теперь понятно, что случилось с бирцами после штурма. Оказалось, что сразу после проникновения отряда персонал Лабиринта запер все входы и выходы в Лабиринт. А затем старший сотрудник выпустил подопытных из клеток. Эти люди уже давно были на грани безумия и истощения, и положили всех бирцов несмотря на то, что были безоружны и не имели боевой подготовки.

Паршивая смерть... Но лучше знать такую правду, чем обманываться.

ro.68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99 questNoteText:
Jaeger’s friend is trying to learn what happened to the BEAR squad that stormed The Labyrinth during the evacuation. The team completed their operation, but then all contact went dead and The Labyrinth was sealed. In exchange for the Knossos keycards, Jaeger wants me to find out what happened to them. I’ll have to carefully sweep all the passages in The Labyrinth and figure out what went on after the assault.

It’s not an easy job, but I’ll get a better understanding of the complex and a chance to dig up TerraGroup research. So it’s worth doing, and it’ll help build my rep with Jaeger. He gave me a Knossos keycard that should open The Labyrinth entrance. The way into the TerraGroup complex is now open.
ro.68ffff8e70ea9e50ee0c9f30 questNoteText: I handed Jaeger the tape detailing what happened to the BEAR squad in The Labyrinth. That was enough, and he said he’d pass it on to his comrade.
ro.68ffff9ab90b93f61a0cf6a2 questNoteText: The squad commander with the call sign Leshy ordered the search for exits to stop and for everyone to regroup at Item 1156. Looks like someone trapped the operatives in The Labyrinth, but it’s unclear how or why. I need to find this "Item" and check things out there.
ro.68ffffa69f98d8e00f0ce6cf questNoteText: I didn’t find Leshy among the operatives at Item 1156. He might have continued searching for exits in The Labyrinth.
ro.68ffffb05d8e37f04d0ae9c9 questNoteText: The squad commander ordered the team to fortify at Item 1156, but for some reason, he himself went outside the perimeter. He’s got a journal, which should hold more information.
ro.68ffffbd2f2048e6e505f0be questNoteText: It looks like TerraGroup was conducting some kind of human experiments in The Labyrinth. When the BEAR squad stormed in, the staff hid deeper inside and opened the cages with the test subjects. But I still haven’t found any of the managers or documents.
ro.68ffffca5d8e37f04d0ae9cc questNoteText: I managed to open the office where the senior Labyrinth staff member had barricaded himself. He killed himself, but before dying, he recorded something on a tape.
ro.68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2 questNoteText:
Now it’s clear what happened to the BEAR squad after the assault. Right after the team got in, the Labyrinth staff locked all the entrances and exits. Then the senior employee released the test subjects from their cages. These people had long been on the brink of madness and exhaustion, and they took out all the BEARs, even though they were unarmed and had no combat training.

A terrible fate… but knowing the truth is better than living a lie.

เพื่อนของ Jaeger กำลังพยายามสืบหาว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับหน่วย BEAR ที่บุกโจมตี The Labyrinth ระหว่างการอพยพ พวกเขาปฏิบัติการเสร็จสิ้นแต่การติดต่อทั้งหมดก็ถูกตัดขาดและ The Labyrinth ก็ถูกปิดลง เพื่อแลกกับคีย์การ์ด Knossos, Jaeger ต้องการให้ฉันสืบหาว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับพวกเขา ฉันจะต้องกวาดล้างทางเดินทั้งหมดใน The Labyrinth  อย่างระมัดระวังและหาคำตอบว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นหลังจากการโจมตี

Na audio pásce vedoucí zaměstnanec Labyrintu řekl, že se pokusí uchovat zprávy o experimentech prováděných v komplexu.
